reason: I'd take the free call and look at the 15 companies, that costs me nothing. But paying 500 up front and 350 a meeting this month, after the last agency gave me slides and nothing? Not until I've seen they can actually open doors in my market.
objection: EUR 350 a meeting sounds like a lot when Apollo and a junior SDR cost less. And '45 meetings in 2 months' is one anonymous client. I've heard numbers like that before, and the meetings turned out to be people who just wanted to chat.
would_change_my_mind: A 15-minute call with that logistics client, the real person, telling me how many of those 45 meetings turned into quote requests or contracts.
